scope: Selected historical observation summaries; no new runtime validation during packaging.

observations.observation: Separate live OAuth contexts sharing storage did not serialize the first colliding refresh; one reauthorized, later cycles used different pairs.
observations.limit: Owned provider rotation policy; no exactly-once guarantee established

observations.observation: Controlled process exit between token and expiry writes left new token pair with prior expiry; SQLite valid; explicit retry repaired test state.
observations.limit: Historical controlled interruption, not proof of natural exploit or automatic recovery

observations.observation: Earlier public-client revocation without client_secret returned invalid_request; confidential-client revocation worked.
observations.limit: Distinct from later server-401 SSE error feedback; no auth bypass

observations.observation: Inherited Windows DACL granted extra modeled SIDs access contrary to the selected owner-only deployment policy.
observations.limit: No real second-user process, key-access or plaintext disclosure established

observations.observation: Server 401; tool body not re-entered; client RPC pending at 2-second bound without RPC deadline; explicit 0.5-second deadline produced MCPError.
observations.limit: No infinite-wait, application-outage or resource-exhaustion proof
